thread:
Jamal: heads up — pile of GPU attach failures in eu-west1 from 07:12–07:22 UTC. jobs keep hitting attach-timeout and then backoff.
Maria: ugh. any ERROR logs? link to stack traces?
Jamal: saw a pattern in node agent: local write latency jumps, kernel shows a lot of small-file delete bursts. iostat snapshot attached:
Jamal: ```
Device    r/s    w/s  rkB/s  wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await r_await w_await svctm  %util
nvme0n1  10     980  1024   24000    26.5     23.1   21.5   0.8    21.5   0.80  82.3
```
Olivia: that avgqu-sz is nasty. %util >80 at peak. did the cleaner run?
Sanjay: looks like janitor job kicked off a deep-clean window at 07:10 for eu-west1. it deletes many tiny files which spikes metadata ops and blocks GPU pod onboarding.
Jamal: confirmed — janitor logs show 1.2M unlink ops over 8 minutes on several scratch volumes.
Maria: timeline aligns with the GPU launch flood. we rollout batch jobs at 07:00 every day (cron). collision.
ops-oncall: @Sanjay can we throttle janitor or shift maintenance window? current mitigation needed ASAP.
Sanjay: quick mitigation: add a delete-rate cap and micro-sleep between batches. proposing: janitorctl set-rate --region eu-west1 --max-iops 2000 --batch-size 100
Sanjay: also temporary opt: pin GPU provisioning to zones with spare healthy SSDs (eu-west2) until cleanup finishes.
infra-bot: bulk action queued: apply-policy janitor-rate-cap eu-west1 (dry-run -> apply)
Olivia: what's the rollback risk? any data integrity concerns from throttling cleaner?
Sanjay: none, cleaner is best-effort. delaying won't lose data; it just postpones reclaim. main risk is capacity pressure if we delay too long — but we have 24h buffer in most pools.
Maria: longer-term we should: spread janitor across time, reduce small-file churn by batching in higher-level store, and add backpressure signals to scheduler so launches respect storage pressure.
Jamal: can we enable a soft-shed policy now? i.e., if node local-io > 60ms, route new GPU pods elsewhere.
Olivia: yes, we have routing toggles. i'll flip soft-shed for eu-west1 zones A/B/C until 07:40 UTC.
ops-oncall: doing it now — marking incident note and alert suppression for attach-timeout for next 30m.
Jamal: after throttling janitor, observed avgqu-sz drop to ~4 within 3 minutes and attach success rate returned to normal.
Maria: nice. file an action item to move daily batch to 02:00 UTC and add a flag in janitor to opt-out high-traffic windows.
Sanjay: filing RFC. will also prototype metadata-sharding to reduce unlink storms.
Olivia: cost note — routing to eu-west2 increases egress/cross-region scheduling cost a bit; ops will estimate and add to runbook.
ops-oncall: incident closed (temporary mitigation). follow-ups: RFC from Sanjay, schedule change from Maria, routing cost estimate from Olivia. :white_check_mark:
